wholePhysicalScope: The old_name and Wikidata on the native mapped footprint identify the original museum address. The current one-metre surface survey supplies relative roof elevations.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the measured mansards, sandstone base, entrance tower and copper lantern.
limitations: The front geometry follows the exact 2008 photograph and official site records. Small ornament, rear sash divisions, finish colors, and the lantern above the numerical survey resolution are estimates.
The scope is the historic Amrumer Straße 32 main building. The adjacent laboratory and factory blocks and the museum’s later premises are outside this model.
